blocks.orig: Into Wild Africa is a tented camp in a completely remote and unique place. Hidden deep in the central Serengeti along the Nyabogati River, it lies 8 kilometres from the nearest road on an amazingly beautiful savannah plain. As such, it’s the perfect place to observe animals as you are surrounded by wildlife at any time of the day… and night!
blocks.html: Into Wild Africa is a tented camp in a truly remote and special location. Tucked away deep in the central Serengeti beside the Nyabogati River, it sits 8 kilometres from the closest road on a stunning savannah plain. That makes it an ideal spot for watching animals, since wildlife surrounds you at every hour of the day… and night!

blocks.orig: The camp is composed of 10 extra large luxury tents (including 2 family tents). Inside each tent, you enjoy the comfort of queen-sized beds, a nice sitting area and an ensuite bathroom with hot water. In the evening, you have dinner in the restaurant tent where a chef and his team prepare delicious and varied food, catering to special preferences and dietary wishes if needed. And, being so remote, after dinner there is nothing better than sitting by the campfire with the vast open sky above you and bush noises all around you.
blocks.html: There are 10 extra large luxury tents in the camp (2 of them family tents). Each tent offers queen-sized beds, a pleasant sitting area and an ensuite bathroom with hot water. In the evening you eat in the restaurant tent, where a chef and his team cook tasty and varied meals and can cater for special preferences and dietary wishes when needed. Because the camp is so remote, there is nothing better after dinner than sitting at the campfire under the wide open sky, with the sounds of the bush all around.
